rule: regular-session news 09:31-15:30 ET, tradable ticker (price>=20, avg vol>=1000/min, avg $vol>=50k/min); move = open of first 1-min bar >= news+60s / close of last bar before news - 1; if move <= -3%: SHORT at that open, cover at close of the bar ending entry+60min (flatten by 15:50 ET)
primary_metric: mean and median net return per trade after 0.10% cost, and after a 0.30% cost (wider small-cap spreads)
pass_if: median gross 60m return < -0.5% AND mean net (0.30% cost) > 0 AND median negative in at least 2 of 3 years
